angle: Shows the theorem through two million-sample simulations that morph skewed and mixture starts toward the bell curve, then pairs an invalid single-salary z-calculation against a valid mean-of-100 one.
angle_detail: Start at [01:38] for the exponential simulation from n=2 toward n=50, then [05:18] for the faster-converging mixture case. The pitfall stretch is [08:29] to [10:51], where standardizing one salary is shown as an error before the mean-of-100 version succeeds near [12:44]. Treat the n-at-least-30 line near [04:43] as rough guidance only, as the video stresses.
